entries.content: Read popup stack code. Found root cause + 3 judgment calls. Questions:

{"questions":[{"question":"Currently the project agent popup stays open in stats view (only the FAB hides in diagram view), while CardActionPopupHost hides all its popups in both diagram and stats view. Which rule should the project popup follow once it is a stack entry?","header":"View modes","multiSelect":false,"options":[{"label":"Host rule: hide in diagrams + stats (Recommended)","description":"Project popup follows the same visibility rule as card popups: hidden while viewMode is 'diagrams' or 'stats', re-shown when returning to the board. Fully uniform, but it is a behavior change: today the popup remains usable in stats view."},{"label":"Keep current: only hide in diagrams","description":"Stack membership and z-order come from the service, but the host gets a per-kind exception keeping project popups visible in stats view."}]},{"question":"On mobile, CardActionPopupHost renders only the top-of-stack entry (open={false} for the rest). Should the project agent popup obey this too?","header":"Mobile","multiSelect":false,"options":[{"label":"Yes, same top-only rule (Recommended)","description":"On mobile only the topmost popup is rendered; opening a card action popup over the project agent popup hides the project one until the card one closes. Also gets Android/mobile back-button dismissal via the existing mobileBackDismiss registration."},{"label":"No, always render project popup","description":"Project popup stays rendered on mobile even when not on top, which on mobile means two full-screen popups overlapping."}]},{"question":"action_conversation_chat.tsx line 49 has `context.kind === 'project'` as a bypass: project conversations always count as visible, because the project popup was never in the stack. entries.label: AskUserQuestion

options.description: Project popup follows the same visibility rule as card popups: hidden while viewMode is 'diagrams' or 'stats', re-shown when returning to the board. Fully uniform, but it is a behavior change: today the popup remains usable in stats view.
options.label: Host rule: hide in diagrams + stats (Recommended)

options.description: Stack membership and z-order come from the service, but the host gets a per-kind exception keeping project popups visible in stats view.
options.label: Keep current: only hide in diagrams

questions.question: Currently the project agent popup stays open in stats view (only the FAB hides in diagram view), while CardActionPopupHost hides all its popups in both diagram and stats view. Which rule should the project popup follow once it is a stack entry?

options.description: On mobile only the topmost popup is rendered; opening a card action popup over the project agent popup hides the project one until the card one closes. Also gets Android/mobile back-button dismissal via the existing mobileBackDismiss registration.
options.label: Yes, same top-only rule (Recommended)

options.description: Project popup stays rendered on mobile even when not on top, which on mobile means two full-screen popups overlapping.
options.label: No, always render project popup

questions.question: On mobile, CardActionPopupHost renders only the top-of-stack entry (open={false} for the rest). Should the project agent popup obey this too?

options.description: Project agent conversations are marked viewed / acknowledged only while the project popup is actually the top stack entry, same as card popups. Consequence: an unseen-result badge on the FAB now survives while a card popup covers the project popup.
options.label: Remove the bypass (Recommended)

options.description: Project conversations keep auto-acknowledging whenever the popup is mounted, even when buried under card popups. Less churn, but the inconsistency the bug report is about persists in the acknowledgement path.
options.label: Keep the bypass

questions.question: action_conversation_chat.tsx line 49 has `context.kind === 'project'` as a bypass: project conversations always count as visible, because the project popup was never in the stack. Remove it now?
